subject: 💷 Payslip Available — $period_name
body:
Dear $staff_name,

Your payslip for the pay period below is now available in the HR portal under My Pay › Payslips.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
PAYSLIP SUMMARY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Staff ID:        $staff_id
Period:          $period_name ($period_start to $period_end)
Pay Date:        $pay_date
Gross Pay:       £$gross_pay
Deductions:      £$total_deductions
Net Pay:         £$net_pay
Record ID:       $record_id

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

The full breakdown — tax, National Insurance, pension, allowances, overtime — is in the portal alongside year-to-date figures.

QUERIES

  • Differences vs last period: usually allowances, overtime, or a tax-code change. Check the breakdown first.
  • Tax code questions: go through HMRC directly; HR cannot change a tax code unilaterally.
  • Anything else: payroll@university.edu — quote Record ID $record_id.

This email is for notification only; no payslip data is attached for security reasons.

Kind regards,
Payroll Team
